detours.why: The Vaughan building (relation/7360877) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the end of a sidewalk spur reached from the east, so the walk from Alice Lloyd goes east past it along the sidewalk and doubles back.

Simpson Memorial Institute (way/384164268) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the East Medical Center Drive sidewalk on its north side, so the walk goes down Observatory Street to Medical Center Drive and back up.

Markley's mapped entrances open north onto East Medical Center Drive and the Thomas Francis building (relation/7360878) is reached from the west, off the Washington Heights sidewalk; no mapped path runs between them, so the walk goes round by Medical Center Drive.
